liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Deal** (2 reviews): Reviewer challenges others to find a better Deal and calls it smoking; Reviewer singles out the Deal as especially hot [13][14]
- **Jack-A-Roe** (1 review): Played in a disco style, likened to the disco Berthas of 1977, but followed by a lively recovery [20]
- **Looks Like Rain** (1 review): Called one of the best ever, possibly the best, version of this song [13]
- **Scarlet Begonias** (1 review): The intro is hot but rough, with heavy, metallic-sounding guitars on a soft reggae-style tune [12]
- **Terrapin Station** (1 review): Jerry flubs the lyrics throughout the song, not just occasionally [20]
- Jerry lets loose raunchy riffs at the end of one song, making it a favorite version [18]

## Setlist highlights

- **we're changing a speaker**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [24]

## The recordings

- **gd1981-07-13.177541.sbd.pcm.dalton.miller.clugston.vocal.phase.repaired.flac1644** (recommended): soundboard; 24 songs; 160 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [1]. Said about its sound: Openings of Feel Like A Stranger and They Love Each Other are clipped, with no patch source available [1]
- **gd1981-07-13.141402.sbd.pcm.dalton.miller.clugston.flac1644**: soundboard; 22 songs; 158 min; rated 3/5 by 1 [2]
- **gd81-07-13.sbd.lai.3903.sbefail.shnf**: soundboard; 20 songs; 157 min; rated 4.05/5 by 21 [3]. Said about its sound: Bass seems over-mixed and loud drums and guitars cause occasional tape distortion, though the soundboard is still enjoyable; Reviewer says the sound quality is not great, though the show itself is wonderful; Sound is not stellar but pretty close to it [12][13][14][15][19][21]
- **gd1981-07-13.138742.sbd.moore.berger.flac16**: soundboard; 20 songs; 162 min [4]

## Around the show

- Large rainbow stretched across the Colorado sky just before curtain time; reviewer recalls a spectacular high-altitude day [17]
- Reviewer lived in Boulder in the early 90s and heard from old-timers that this show was hot [21]
- Many tempos are fast, including Deal, Fire, and Estimated Prophet, perhaps too fast for some tastes [20]
- Reviewer suggests checking out 7-4-81 as another show with good fidelity for 1981 [22]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1981-07-13.177541.sbd.pcm.dalton.miller.clugston.vocal.phase.repaired.flac1644**: taped by Tim Dalton; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Dan Healy's Master Soundboard Cassettes (Sony TC-D5M/TDK MA-R90) > Frank Streeter's Reel to Reel @ 3.75 ips (Sony TC770/Maxell UD35-90B) > Tim Dalton's PCM… [1]. Also: Source is PCM from Tim Dalton, transferred by Charlie Miller, with pitch correction help from Joe B. Jones and vocal phase repair by Miller; A Nakamichi 104 source from Ohr Weinberg and Anne Cohen patches Terrapin Station and the Black Peter to Sugar Magnolia transition [1]
- **gd1981-07-13.141402.sbd.pcm.dalton.miller.clugston.flac1644**: taped by Tim Dalton; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: Source Info: Dan Healy's Master Soundboard Cassettes (Sony TC-D5M/TDK MA-R90) > Frank Streeter's Reel to Reel @ 3.75 ips (Sony TC770/Maxell UD35-90B) > Tim… [2]. Also: Source is PCM from Tim Dalton, transferred by Charlie Miller; a Nakamichi 300 source from Brian Schley and Andrew F supplies patches [2]
- **gd81-07-13.sbd.lai.3903.sbefail.shnf**: transferred by Mike Lai; source: Soundboard [3]
- **gd1981-07-13.138742.sbd.moore.berger.flac16**: taped by Jerry Moore; transferred by Rob Berger; source: source: SBD; Jerry Moore’s 2nd gen cassette; maxell mx90’s/dolby b; nakamichi dragon/b > benchmark adc1 @ 24/96 > adobe audition cc > fission > xACT flac16;… [4]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Jerry Garcia: [1981-07-14 McNichols Sports Arena, Denver, CO, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1981-07-14-mcnichols-sports-arena-denver-co-usa/) [25]
